name: the Embodied Hand
note: Agent BUILD orders now travel within placement reach, confirm from the ordering body, and fail unreachable terrain honestly. Hash RE-PINNED a FOURTH time at drain (s2382) with a named cause per F-1441-3, and the era deliberately NOT bumped: the toolsurface-terrain-edge slice removed a module-scope `import * as Terrain` from src/agent/ToolSurface.ts and now takes buildTargetReachable through the existing ToolSurfaceOptions bag, touching src/agent/ToolSurface.ts, src/game/Game.ts, src/mp/AgentRiderBody.ts and src/sim/HeadlessContractSim.ts -- all inside ENGINE_SOURCE_INPUTS' 'src' entry, so the constant HAD to move. It is a MODULE-GRAPH change, not a behavioural one: the static import made src/world/Terrain's Vite-only `?raw` import reachable from e2e collection and left the WHOLE Playwright suite uncollectable (`Total: 0 tests in 0 files`, rc=1). Every production composition root injects the genuine Terrain.isBuildable -- Game.ts:2500 (AgentStub), Game.ts:4210 (AgentRiderBody) and HeadlessContractSim.ts:1032 -- so an agent's build-reachability answers are byte-for-byte what they were; the permissive `() => true` default is reachable only from e2e specs that construct a bare surface, whose own placement adapters remain authoritative. Measured on the merged tree at drain: collection 0 -> 2996 tests in 431 files, tsc clean, build green, test:node-guards 549/557 with the 3 reds attributed (this pin, one pre-existing at 9c379ffde, one environmental). Era 4 remains the s2372 behavioural change and nothing else; the merge is why the constant moved. Prior era-4 pins were dbf8b14e then d5b04061 then c306f1c0.
